title: 通胀越高：美联储反而，越可能不动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jim Caron of Market Stanley writing reduced communication by the Fed could result in more volatility.
segments.zh: 摩根士丹利的吉姆·卡隆表示，美联储减少沟通可能导致市场波动加剧。

segments.en: These changes may have valuation implications despite healthy earnings and broader market participation.
segments.zh: 尽管盈利稳健且市场参与度提升，这些变化可能影响估值。

segments.en: Jim joins us now for more, Jim. Great to see you. Thank you so much for being with us.
segments.zh: 吉姆现在加入我们，很高兴见到你，感谢你的到来。

segments.en: How important is Wednesday's data? I think it's critical.
segments.zh: 周三的数据有多重要？我认为至关重要。

segments.en: The reason is that this will be the hurdle that probably makes the decision whether or not the Fed moves in September, meaning clearly the jobs data has been weak.
segments.zh: 原因是这可能是决定美联储是否在9月行动的关键，显然就业数据一直疲软。

segments.en: But if you get a hot CPI number that comes out, that's going to create some problems.
segments.zh: 但如果CPI数据过热，那将带来一些问题。

segments.en: I mean, for right now, I think you can reduce the odds of a Fed rate hike in September.
segments.zh: 目前来看，我认为可以降低美联储9月加息的可能性。

segments.en: But of course, CPI coming in somewhere around 2.5, 2.4% consensus, then I think September is not going to be a meeting that's really a live meeting where the Fed will make any action.
segments.zh: 当然，如果CPI在2.5%或2.4%左右，符合预期，那么9月会议可能不会采取行动。

segments.en: But if it does come out hotter than that, and it shows that there are some lingering effects in that it's necessary for the Fed to hike to contain that, then that can really create
segments.zh: 但如果数据高于预期，显示通胀有持续影响，美联储需要加息来控制，那将真正引发市场不确定性。

segments.en: some uncertainty in the markets. How much does it really matter? I mean, at a certain point, we've seen stocks continue to gain despite some of the volatility or at least the increase of longer term yields.
segments.zh: 这有多重要？尽管存在波动或长期收益率上升，市场仍在上涨。

segments.en: And we've seen overall market volatility actually not materially go up.
segments.zh: 我们看到整体市场波动实际上并未显著上升。

segments.en: So how much do Fed rate moves really matter for equity space for potentially other risk assets?
segments.zh: 那么，美联储的利率变动对权益资产及其他风险资产的影响究竟有多大？
